summary_1line: Savitri reveals how she won boons from Yama restoring Satyavan and Dyumatsena; the king regains his throne, fulfilling her vows and prosperity for both families.

image_candidates.scene_text: Savitri stands before the forest sages recounting how Yama took Satyavan's soul while the hermitage fires glow in the night.
Messengers from Salwa arrive at the forest hermitage announcing the usurper's death as the newly sighted Dyumatsena looks on in astonishment.
Priests ceremonially seat Dyumatsena on the throne while Savitri and Satyavan stand beside him amid rejoicing courtiers.
